description: This national dataset measures road-network density in one-kilometre grid cells across China for 2019. The China Land Surveying and Planning Institute and the Ministry of Natural Resources Land Science Data Center derived centre lines from the Third National Land Survey, including railway land, highways, urban and village roads, and rail transit. ScienceDB hosts the resulting density product and documentation. Repository metadata assigns CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, permitting free non-commercial reuse with attribution and share-alike conditions. The inspected metadata does not state a file format. Density is an aggregate indicator and cannot replace connected links in a traffic assignment model. It can provide spatial development or accessibility proxies for planning simulations. It complements data-openstreetmap where a separate routable network is required.
